name: What is the typical timeline for attached ADU construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for attached ADU construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for attached ADU construction varies but generally ranges from 6 to 12 months, including design, permitting, and construction. The permitting phase can take several weeks to months, depending on your local jurisdiction's review processes in cities like Berkeley or Oakland. Construction itself typically takes 3-6 months. We work to streamline the process, ensuring efficient project management from initial consultation to final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attached ADU construction typically takes 6 to 12 months, encompassing design, permitting, and the physical build.
